findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "place_paid_order" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: paid_order_status · Private data: paid_order_status, place_paid_order · Public sink: paid_order_status, place_paid_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: paid_order_status · Private data: paid_order_status, place_paid_order · Public sink: paid_order_status, place_paid_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
